model_claims.text: The fix preserves UTF-16/32 reverse line boundaries.
model_claims.source_quote: fix: preserve UTF-16/32 reverse line boundaries

model_claims.text: Before the fix, `reverse_iter_lines` splits encoded bytes before decoding, so valid UTF-16/32 lines can raise `UnicodeDecodeError` or split inside a code unit.
model_claims.source_quote: `reverse_iter_lines` splits encoded bytes before decoding, so valid UTF-16/32 lines can raise `UnicodeDecodeError` or split inside a code unit.

model_claims.text: The fix decodes complete UTF-16/32 chunks before separating CR/LF lines, keeping surrogate pairs together at block boundaries.
model_claims.source_quote: Decode complete UTF-16/32 chunks before separating CR/LF lines, keeping surrogate pairs together at block boundaries.

model_claims.text: Generic codecs honor and consume the leading BOM or use native byte order without one, matching `bytes.decode`; explicit endian codecs retain U+FEFF.
model_claims.source_quote: Generic codecs honor and consume the leading BOM or use native byte order without one, matching `bytes.decode`; explicit endian codecs retain U+FEFF.

model_claims.text: Reads remain bounded by the requested block size rounded to a code unit, plus a two-byte UTF-16 lookbehind.
model_claims.source_quote: Reads remain bounded by the requested block size rounded to a code unit, plus a two-byte UTF-16 lookbehind.

model_claims.text: Existing byte, UTF-8, Latin-1 and StringIO paths retain their delimiter behavior.
model_claims.source_quote: Existing byte, UTF-8, Latin-1 and StringIO paths retain their delimiter behavior.

items.about: Tests for C1, C2, C3: UTF-16 surrogate pair with newline, blocksize=1

claims.text: The fix preserves UTF-16/32 reverse line boundaries.
Before the fix, `reverse_iter_lines` splits encoded bytes before decoding, so valid UTF-16/32 lines can raise `UnicodeDecodeError` or split inside a code unit.
The fix decodes complete UTF-16/32 chunks before separating CR/LF lines, keeping surrogate pairs together at block boundaries.
